overloads.semanticRole: The SOAP Get info command retrieves, in the form of a character string, the different types of information concerning a SOAP request.

constraints: infoNum selects which piece of SOAP request metadata to retrieve, e.g. 1 = name of the Web Service method about to execute, 2 = name of the Web Service the method belongs to.
Intended to be called from within the On Web Authentication Database Method to inspect an incoming SOAP request (e.g. for security checks) before it is otherwise available.
